title: Umami Brazilian Prosciutto Pão de Queijo
description: A rich and savory twist on traditional Brazilian cheese bread, featuring prosciutto and a dash of umami flavor.
instructions: Preheat the pressure cooker to high heat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and kosher salt.
Add the shredded Parmesan and cheddar cheese to the dry ingredients and mix until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and warm milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Cut the rested dough into 6 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place 1 slice of prosciutto on each disk, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough over the prosciutto, pressing the edges together to seal the pão de queijo.
Place the pão de queijo in the pressure cooker, seam-side down, and close the lid.
Cook for 10 minutes at high pressure, followed by a 5-minute natural release.
Transfer the pão de queijo to a wire rack and let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.
